Pela el kiwi con una cuchara: clava la p: Peel the kiwi with a spoon: push the tip in between skin and flesh and turn the fruit round. It comes out whole and clean, with nothing wasted.
Pela el pepino a tiras (dejando algo de: Peel the cucumber in stripes (leaving some skin on) and cut it into half-moons.
Pela el pepino a tiras y córtalo en bast: Peel the cucumber in stripes and cut it into sticks. Eat the warm tempeh with the cucumber and the soy sauce to dip.
Pela la batata y córtala en dados de dos: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into two-centimetre cubes. Boil it for 12 minutes in salted water, until a knife goes in without effort.
Peel the sweet potato and cut it into two-centimetre cubes. Spread it on the tray with a tablespoon of oil and salt, in a single layer.
Pela la naranja a lo vivo: corta los dos: Peel the orange down to the flesh: cut off both ends, stand it up and work the skin off from top to bottom with the knife, including the white pith (it is bitter). Cut it into slices.
Pela la naranja quitando toda la parte b: Peel the orange, taking off all the white pith, which is bitter, and separate it into segments.
Pela la naranja y sepárala en gajos. Com: Peel the orange and separate it into segments. Eat the peanuts with the orange.
Pela la zanahoria y córtala en dados peq: Peel the carrot and cut it into small cubes. Cook it for 8 minutes in a pan with a finger of water and a tablespoon of oil, until tender.
Pela la zanahoria y córtala en rodajas f: Peel the carrot and cut it into thin rounds. Boil it for 6 minutes in salted boiling water, tender but still holding together.
Pela la zanahoria y córtala en tiras fin: Peel the carrot and cut it into thin strips or grate it coarsely: it goes in raw, it is what brings the crunch.
Pela la zanahoria, córtala en rodajas fi: Peel the carrot, cut it into thin rounds and cook it for 8 minutes in another pan with a finger of water and a tablespoon of oil.
Pela la zanahoria, córtala en rodajas y: Peel the carrot, cut it into rounds and boil it for 6 minutes in salted water.
Pela los huevos bajo el grifo con agua f: Peel the eggs under cold running water: the shell comes off in one piece.
Pela los langostinos cocidos si vienen c: Peel the cooked king prawns with your hands if they come in their shells (head, legs, body).
Pela y corta el pepino en medias lunas f: Peel the cucumber and cut it into thin half-moons.
Pela y corta la zanahoria en rodajas fin: Peel the carrot, cut it into thin rounds and put it in the pot with half a litre of water and a tablespoon of oil.
Pela y trocea la zanahoria y cuécela 10: Peel and chop the carrot and cook it for 10 minutes in the pot with half a litre of water, until very soft. To blend it, it has to be MORE cooked than you would want to eat it whole.
Pélalo y córtalo en rodajas de un dedo d: Peel it and cut it into finger-thick slices, or eat it whole if you do not mind.
Pélalos bajo un hilo de agua, empezando: Peel them under a trickle of water, starting from the fat end.
Pica fina la cebolla, la zanahoria y el: Finely chop the onion, the carrot and the pepper. Soften them in a pot with a tablespoon of oil over a medium heat for 8 minutes, until the onion is translucent.
Pica la cebolla fina y póchala en una sa: Finely chop the onion and soften it in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium heat for 6 minutes. Add the chopped garlic for 30 seconds more.
Finely chop the onion and soften it in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-low heat for 10 minutes, until soft and golden. Do not rush: that is where the flavour is.
Pica la cebolla y el pimiento y póchalos: Chop the onion and the pepper and soften them in a pan (ovenproof if you have one, otherwise you can transfer to a dish later) with two tablespoons of oil over a medium heat for 8 minutes.
Chop the onion and the pepper and soften them in a pan with two tablespoons of oil over a medium heat for 8 minutes. Add the chopped garlic for 30 seconds.
Pica las almendras aplastándolas con el: Chop the almonds by crushing them with the flat of a wide knife on the board, or break them with your fingers, and scatter them at the end.
Pica las almendras en trozos grandes: en: Chop the almonds into large pieces: whole, they are awkward to eat with a spoon.
Pica las almendras en trozos grandes: po: Chop the almonds into large pieces: put them on the board and crush them with the flat of a wide knife, or break them with your fingers.
Pica las nueces en trozos grandes con el: Chop the walnuts into large pieces with the flat of the knife or with your fingers: whole, they are hard to spread around.
Pica las nueces y repártelas por encima: Chop the walnuts and scatter them over the top with a drizzle of honey.
Pimienta y el jugo dorado de la sartén p: Pepper, and the browned juices from the pan poured over.
Pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
Pepper and a drizzle of raw oil.
Pimienta y un hilo de aceite crudo. Sal: Pepper and a drizzle of raw oil. Salt to taste (sliced turkey already brings some).
Pimienta, un hilo de aceite crudo y ques: Pepper, a drizzle of raw oil and grated cheese if you have some.
Pimienta, un hilo de aceite crudo y toma: Pepper, a drizzle of raw oil and some tomato sauce if you want it moister.
Pimienta, un hilo de aceite crudo y, si: Pepper, a drizzle of raw oil and, if you have it, a pinch of chilli or oregano. Check the seasoning: the tuna is already salted.
Pimienta, unas gotas de limón y eneldo s: Pepper, a few drops of lemon and dill if you have some.
Pimienta. NO añadas sal: la pone el jamó: Pepper. Do NOT add salt: the ham brings it.
Pimiento sin las venas blancas (amargan): Pepper with the white pith removed (it is bitter), cut into strips, over a high heat for 6 minutes until it takes on dark patches. Take it out.
Pepper with the white pith removed (it is bitter), cut into strips, fried over a high heat for 6 minutes until it takes on dark patches.
Pepper with the white pith removed (it is bitter), in strips. High heat for 6 minutes until it takes on dark patches. Take it out.
Pepper with the white pith removed (it is bitter), in strips. Fry it over a high heat for 6 minutes until it takes on dark patches. Take it out.
Pimiento sin venas blancas en tiras, a f: Pepper with the white pith removed, in strips, over a high heat for 6 minutes until it takes on dark patches.
Pimiento sin venas blancas en tiras, fue: Pepper with the white pith removed, in strips, high heat for 6 minutes until it takes on dark patches. Take it out.
Plancha la pechuga seca y salada 4-5 min: Griddle the breast, dried and salted, for 4-5 minutes a side and cut it into strips.
Pon a calentar en un cazo unos 8 cm de a: Heat about 8 cm of water in a pan. When small bubbles start to rise from the bottom, without it reaching a rolling boil, turn the heat down. If it boils hard, the egg falls apart.
Pon agua a hervir con una cucharada de s: Put water on to boil with a tablespoon of salt. There is no need to thaw the edamame first.
Pon dos dedos de agua en la olla con un: Put two fingers of water in the pot with a metal colander on top, not touching the water, and bring it to the boil.
Pon dos dedos de agua en una olla con un: Put two fingers of water in a pot with a metal colander on top, not touching the water, and bring it to the boil.
Put two fingers of water in a pot with a metal colander on top, with the water not touching the colander, and bring it to the boil.
Pon el agua de la pasta a hervir con una: Put the pasta water on to boil with a heaped tablespoon of salt (skip this if it comes ready cooked).
Put the pasta water on to boil with a heaped tablespoon of salt.
Pon el arroz a hervir con el doble de ag: Put the rice on to boil in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt: 15-18 minutes, until it has drunk the water.
Pon el atún por encima y aplástalo un po: Put the tuna on top and press it down a little with the fork so it does not fall off as you bite.
Pon el bacalao con la piel hacia abajo y: Lay the cod skin side down and leave it 8 minutes over a low heat. The skin gradually releases a gelatine that clouds the oil: THAT gelatine is the sauce.
Pon el bacalao encima en lascas. Pimient: Put the cod on top in flakes. Pepper.
Pon el bacalao encima. Sal con cuidado,: Put the cod on top. Salt carefully, even desalted it is salty.
Pon el filete y no lo toques: 2 minutos: Lay the steak down and do not touch it: 2 minutes for rare, 3 for medium, 4 for well done. Turn it once only.
Pon el huevo a cocer cubierto de agua fr: Put the egg on to boil covered in cold water, two fingers above it, and count 10 minutes from the moment it reaches a rolling boil.
Pon el huevo a cocer: cúbrelo con agua f: Put the egg on to boil: cover it with cold water, bring it to the boil and count 10 minutes from the moment it bubbles.
Put the egg on top and break it as you eat. This is the trickiest step on the list: if your first attempt falls apart, you have done nothing wrong.
Pon el hummus en un cuenco pequeño y col: Put the hummus in a small bowl and arrange the sticks around it. Serve it separately rather than poured over: mixed in, the vegetables go soft.
Pon el jamón cocido por encima en tiras: Put the cooked ham over the top in wide strips.
Pon el pan a tostar ahora: los huevos re: Put the bread on to toast now: scrambled eggs take two minutes and wait for nobody.
Pon el pan a tostar mientras y sírvelo a: Put the bread on to toast in the meantime and serve it alongside for dipping, which is how it is eaten.
Pon el pan a tostar y escurre bien el at: Put the bread on to toast and drain the tuna well.
Pon el pavo en lonchas sobre el pan y lo: Lay the sliced turkey on the bread and the hot mushrooms on top.
Pon el pavo en lonchas y el calabacín en: Lay the sliced turkey down and the courgette on top.
Pon el pavo y el tomate en dados en el t: Put the turkey and the diced tomato on the bottom third, not in the middle.
Pon el pollo encima con el jugo dorado d: Put the chicken on top with the browned juices from the pan.
Pon el pollo y NO lo toques durante 4 mi: Lay the chicken down and do NOT touch it for 4 minutes: move it and it will not brown.
Pon el queso fresco batido en un bol y r: Put the quark in a bowl and stir it a little to loosen it.
Put the quark in a bowl and scatter the kiwi over it.
Put the quark in a bowl and scatter the apple over it.
Pon el queso fresco batido en un bol, añ: Put the quark in a bowl, add the orange and leave the granola until last, just before eating, or it goes soft.
Pon el queso pegado al pan por los dos l: Put the cheese right against the bread on both sides: it seals the crumb.
